lines.zh: 我们三个并排，编号不同的同一张脸。
lines.en: Three abreast, the same face under different numbers.

lines.zh: 我踩着气往前，队形不乱。
lines.en: I move on ki and the formation stays tight.
The readout on my visor keeps jumping.

lines.zh: 我跟着队长的手势变向。
lines.en: I follow the squad leader's hand signal.
We skim the grass tips without landing.

lines.zh: 肩膀上那口气推着我走。
lines.en: The ki at my shoulders pushes me along.

lines.zh: 一个人的时候我叫一号，现在没名字。
lines.en: Alone I am number one. In the squad I have no name.

lines.zh: 队列整齐，谁掉队谁倒霉。
lines.en: The line stays even; stragglers pay for it.

lines.zh: 我们的脚步其实没声音。
lines.en: Our steps make no sound at all.

lines.zh: 我压低高度，贴着石头飞。
lines.en: I drop low and skim the rocks.

lines.zh: 三个人，三条路线，一个命令。
lines.en: Three soldiers, three routes, one order.

lines.zh: 我把手抬到额头，敬了个礼。
lines.en: I touch my brow in a quick salute.

lines.zh: 我们停在半空，等下一步命令。
lines.en: We halt in the air and wait for the next order.

lines.zh: 我调了调护目镜的带子。
lines.en: I adjust the strap on my visor.

lines.zh: 三个人都没说话，只有气在响。
lines.en: None of us speak; only the ki hums.

lines.zh: 我把爆能炮的保险关上。
lines.en: I click the safety on my blaster.
The leader studies a map. I watch him.

lines.zh: 这个星球的草比我家乡的高。
lines.en: The grass here is taller than at home.
I scrape the mud off my boots.

lines.zh: 训练里没人教过站这么久。
lines.en: Training never covered standing this long.

lines.zh: 我偷偷活动了一下脚踝。
lines.en: I secretly roll my ankle.
A bird crosses the distance. I watch it fly.

lines.zh: 换岗还有很久，我数着呼吸。
lines.en: Relief is far off; I count my breaths.

lines.zh: 我们在等，等到有人先动。
lines.en: We are waiting for someone to move first.

lines.zh: 风把我的气吹得散了些。
lines.en: The wind scatters my aura a little.

lines.zh: 我的手套磨破了一个洞。
lines.en: There is a hole worn in my glove.
Stop and submit to inspection.

lines.zh: 你的战斗力，护目镜上写着。
lines.en: Your power level is on my visor.
Raise your hands. Slowly.

lines.zh: 这片区域由弗利萨军管辖。
lines.en: This region is under Frieza Force control.
You came alone? Foolish.
Identify yourself. Do not make me guess.

lines.zh: 我们的编号不需要告诉你。
lines.en: Our numbers are none of your concern.
Put your weapon on the ground.

lines.zh: 我见过很多像你这样的人。
lines.en: I have seen many like you.
Three of us. You have no chance.
Do not retreat. Retreating makes us faster.
Three seconds to decide.

lines.zh: 他看着我的护目镜，没看懂。
lines.en: He stares at my visor and understands nothing.
This is not a negotiation, only a question.
Is anyone else with you?
Lift your face so I can confirm.

lines.zh: 我的手套已经够在扳机上了。
lines.en: My glove is already on the trigger.
Your silence reads as refusal.
My armor split. I give half a step.
That caught me off guard and it aches.
I clamp the wound; the formation holds.
My squadmates are up. I will not fall.

lines.zh: 我的护目镜摔碎了镜片。
lines.en: A lens has cracked in my visor.
I take a breath and the aura brightens.

lines.zh: 血滴在胸口，编号看不清了。
lines.en: Blood on my chest blurs the number.
It came fast. It will heal fast.
I am still standing. That is the answer.

lines.zh: 打在我的编号上，我记住了。
lines.en: That landed on my number. Noted.
Rations? I take mine first.
The three of us split that bag.
Smells like nutrient paste.
You never get full in a garrison.
I tuck the ration into my waist pouch.

lines.zh: 队长没看见，我先咬一口。
lines.en: The leader is not looking. One bite.
This beats standard issue.
No grabbing. Everyone gets a share.
I smell meat. I am truly hungry.

lines.zh: 吃完再巡逻，不差这点时间。
lines.en: We eat first, then patrol. No hurry.
Out of the way. We travel in straight lines.
You bumped my armor.
Which of the three of us can you push?

lines.zh: 我侧身，队形一乱就麻烦。
lines.en: I sidestep; a broken formation is trouble.
Do not block the rear of the column.
That bump is not worth my attention.
He collides, then backs off again.

lines.zh: 我们肩甲并着，你过不去。
lines.en: Our pauldrons meet. You cannot pass.
After a collision, a report is filed.
To the left. Do not walk on our shadows.
We were not built in pairs.

lines.zh: 同一批里，只有编号不同。
lines.en: The same batch, only the numbers differ.

lines.zh: 有人喜欢过同队的人，被调走了。
lines.en: One of us loved a squadmate. He was reassigned.

lines.zh: 军营里没这条规定，也没这个时间。
lines.en: No rule forbids it. There is simply no time.

lines.zh: 我们背靠背睡，这样就够。
lines.en: We sleep back to back. That is enough.

lines.zh: 她也是士兵，我们从不提以后。
lines.en: She is a soldier too. We never speak of later.

lines.zh: 我的护目镜里存着她的编号。
lines.en: Her number is stored in my visor.

lines.zh: 三个人的队伍，没有秘密。
lines.en: A squad of three keeps no secrets.

lines.zh: 如果我死了，别写我的名字。
lines.en: If I die, do not write my name.

lines.zh: 我们把同一份口粮分成两半。
lines.en: We split one ration into two halves.

lines.zh: 这枚徽章是上批留下的。
lines.en: This badge is left from the last batch.

lines.zh: 我捡起掉落的爆能炮零件。
lines.en: I collect a dropped blaster part.

lines.zh: 石头我拿了一块，压地图用。
lines.en: I take a stone to weigh down the map.
Half an energy cell lies on the ground.
This iron scrap counts as spoils.
I hang my number tag back on its cord.

lines.zh: 手套捡到了，正好是我的尺码。
lines.en: A glove on the ground. My size exactly.

lines.zh: 地上的东西登记完再分。
lines.en: Ground finds are logged and then divided.

lines.zh: 这些全要上交，规矩如此。
lines.en: All of this goes up the chain. Regulation.

lines.zh: 我拾起一片反光的东西。
lines.en: I pick up something reflective.
The visor pings. A target.
Contact at three o'clock.
All three of us saw it at once.

lines.zh: 他的气太弱，我都懒得动。
lines.en: His ki is so weak I barely care.
The order is capture, not kill.
The target runs for the trees.
I signal my squadmates to flank.
This reading is not worth reporting.
He stopped to find a way out.

lines.zh: 我的气圆斩已经抬手了。
lines.en: My arm is already up for the disc.
Locked. Passing control up the chain.

lines.zh: 我数一二三，我们一起上。
lines.en: I count to three and we all move.

lines.zh: 那人穿着我们没见过的甲。
lines.en: He wears armor we do not recognize.

lines.zh: 目标锁定，没有别的意思。
lines.en: Target acquired. Nothing personal.
He came out from behind the rock.
The visor does not lie.

lines.zh: 我们分开站位，堵住出口。
lines.en: We spread out and close the exits.
He looks both ways. Both are covered.
I wait for my squadmate's mark.
That gap is one dash away.
He tried to run and was cut off.
The target is wheezing. The formation holds.
I hear footsteps on the far side.
We have formed a half circle.

lines.zh: 他在找我们三个的破绽。
lines.en: He is hunting for a gap between us.
The leader has not ordered it. I wait.
His hand moves for his weapon.
I press half a block closer.
My ki stays pointed at him.
He backs to the corner and stops.
Three of us rotate. You get no opening.
He shouted once. No one answered.

lines.zh: 再撑一会儿，他就撑不住了。
lines.en: A little longer and he breaks.

lines.zh: 读数在掉，他快没气力了。
lines.en: The reading is falling. He is nearly spent.
My fist lands on his chest plate.
A small ki blast bursts at his feet.
I crash into him from the side.
He guards left; I hit right.
My knee finds his ribs.
The three of us pin him down together.
My elbow cracks his jaw.

lines.zh: 气弹擦着他的手臂过去。
lines.en: The blast grazes his arm.

lines.zh: 他被我踢得滑出去几步。
lines.en: My kick slides him back several steps.

lines.zh: 我抓住他的领口往上提。
lines.en: I seize his collar and haul him up.
The first fist passes, the second lands.
He swings; I take it on my bracer.

lines.zh: 我照着同队教过的打法出手。
lines.en: I strike exactly as the squad drilled.
He drops and we step forward.
The bolt bursts against his chest.
I hold him until he stops moving.

lines.zh: 我们三个一起降落在空地上。
lines.en: The three of us land together in the clearing.
Visors light up and the scan begins.

lines.zh: 从运输船上下来的，排成一列。
lines.en: Off the transport, we form a line.
One face, three numbers.

lines.zh: 我们的气在草地上压出圆圈。
lines.en: Our ki presses a circle into the grass.
The leader lands; we follow.

lines.zh: 这片地，弗利萨军接管了。
lines.en: The Frieza Force takes this ground.
I settle my ki and lift half a block.

lines.zh: 靴子一落地，报告就发出去了。
lines.en: Boots touch down and the report is already sent.
We fan out in three directions.

lines.zh: 早上刚换的护甲，还硬着。
lines.en: Fresh armor this morning, still stiff.
Someone has been moving through here.

lines.zh: 降落点选得不好，全是泥。
lines.en: Poor landing spot. All mud.
We give each other a single nod.
A fresh batch, the same orders.
I take second position by my number.

lines.zh: 气流卷起尘土，我们等着。
lines.en: Dust swirls and we stand ready.
The line is set. I scan the surroundings.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的护目镜，我甩头。
lines.en: Flames caught my visor and I shake my head.

lines.zh: 我从空中掉了下去，砸在土里。
lines.en: I dropped out of the air and hit the soil.
I sink and the water blocks my ki.
The blast threw me onto the rocks.

lines.zh: 一支箭射穿了我的护腕。
lines.en: An arrow punched through my bracer.

lines.zh: 奇怪的力量压着我的气。
lines.en: Some odd force is pressing my ki down.

lines.zh: 补给没到，我的动作慢了。
lines.en: The supply run is late and my moves slowed.
Lightning scattered my aura.

lines.zh: 我掉进了什么都不剩的地方。
lines.en: I fell into a place where nothing remains.
